title: The Mystery of Food
introduction: ‘The Mystery of Food’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects what food contains, balanced meals, food preservation, microorganisms and spoilage, safe food practices. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
